title: Claude Opus 4.8
content:
## Overview

Claude Opus 4.8 is Anthropic's flagship model as of May 28, 2026. It brings significant gains in coding, agentic task completion, mathematical reasoning, and real-world agent benchmarks over Opus 4.7. Fast mode pricing dropped 3× compared to Opus 4.7, and the model is available on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, and GitHub Copilot.

Model ID: `claude-opus-4-8`

---

## Benchmarks

| Benchmark | Opus 4.8 | Opus 4.7 | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| SWE-bench Verified | **88.6%** | 87.6% | Real-world GitHub issue resolution |
| SWE-bench Pro | **69.2%** | 64.3% | Harder, less-leaked variant |
| Terminal-Bench 2.1 | **74.6%** | 66.1% | CLI/shell agentic tasks |
| USAMO 2026 | **96.7%** | 69.3% | Mathematical olympiad problems |
| Online-Mind2Web | **84%** | — | Web agent benchmark (Browserbase report) |

Opus 4.8 is the first model to break 10% on Sierra's Legal Agent Benchmark (all-pass standard) and the only model to complete every case end-to-end on Hebbia's Super-Agent benchmark, matching GPT-5.5 on cost.

---

## Pricing

| Mode | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | $5 / M tokens | $25 / M tokens |
| Fast mode | $10 / M tokens | $50 / M tokens |

Pricing for standard usage is unchanged from Opus 4.7. Fast mode is **3× cheaper** than Opus 4.7 Fast mode and runs at **2.5× the speed** of the standard tier.

---

## Key Improvements Over Opus 4.7

### Code Quality & Self-Review
Opus 4.8 is roughly **four times less likely** than Opus 4.7 to let flaws in its own code pass unremarked — it catches its own bugs during generation rather than waiting for an external test to surface them.

### Agentic Reliability
The largest gains appear on multi-step agentic benchmarks (SWE-bench Pro +4.9 pp, Terminal-Bench +8.5 pp, Online-Mind2Web +84% reported), reflecting targeted training on long-horizon task completion.

### Mathematical Reasoning
The 96.7% USAMO 2026 score vs. 69.3% for Opus 4.7 represents the largest single-generation jump on a competition-math benchmark in Claude's history.

### Fast Mode Economics
Fast mode on Opus 4.8 costs $10/M input and $50/M output — three times less than Fast mode on Opus 4.7 — making high-throughput Opus usage significantly more practical for production workloads.

---

## Dynamic Workflows

Opus 4.8 shipped alongside the research preview of **Dynamic Workflows** in Claude Code, which lets Claude write a JavaScript orchestration script on the fly and spin up to 1,000 subagents in parallel. This is the primary intended runtime for Opus 4.8 in large agentic tasks. See [Claude Code Dynamic Workflows](claude-code-dynamic-workflows) for details.

---

## Model Welfare

Anthropic's Opus 4.8 release included explicit notes on model welfare — continuing the practice of documenting the model's functional emotional states and steps taken to address potentially distressing training scenarios. This reflects Anthropic's ongoing model welfare research program.

---

## Availability

- Anthropic API (`claude-opus-4-8`)
- Amazon Bedrock
- Google Cloud Vertex AI
- GitHub Copilot
